baseline: Versions observed on the development host; see doc/getting-started/building.md for qualification scope. Archives require an explicit per-host URL and SHA-256 in an override lock.

cmake.remediation: Install CMake 4.4.0, or explicitly import another version with --allow-version-override.

ninja.remediation: Install Ninja 1.12.1, or explicitly import another version with --allow-version-override.

arm-gcc.remediation: Install Arm GNU Toolchain 15.2.Rel1 with its matching libstdc++, then pass --tool arm-gcc=/absolute/path/to/arm-none-eabi-g++.

riscv-gcc.remediation: Install ESP-IDF v6.1's esp-15.2.0_20251204 toolchain, then pass --tool riscv-gcc=/absolute/path/to/riscv32-esp-elf-g++.

esp-idf.remediation: Obtain ESP-IDF v6.1 and its pinned submodules at commit fff9895c82d744c7237be8847347bdd1b07c6643, run its platform installer, then pass --tool esp-idf=/absolute/path/to/esp-idf.

idf-python.remediation: Use the Python environment created by ESP-IDF v6.1's installer: --tool idf-python=/absolute/path/to/venv/bin/python (Scripts/python.exe on Windows).

idf-tools.remediation: Import the ESP-IDF v6.1 tools root containing espidf.constraints.v6.1.txt: --tool idf-tools=/absolute/path/to/tools.

openocd.remediation: Install OpenOCD 0.12.0 including interface/stlink.cfg and target/stm32h7x.cfg; use --tool openocd=/absolute/path/to/openocd.

jlink.remediation: Install SEGGER J-Link 9.76; use --tool jlink=/absolute/path/to/JLinkExe (JLink.exe on Windows).
